items.heading: These Are Not Two Versions
items.text: These are not two versions of the same decision. An MSCS is a specialization move: it takes an engineering background and makes it deeper, narrower, and more technically valuable. An MBA is a pivot move: it takes an engineering background and repositions it toward management, strategy, or business leadership, usually at the cost of some technical depth.

items.heading: Before Comparing Cost or Salary,
items.text: Before comparing cost or salary, it helps to see what each degree is structurally built to produce, since that decides whether the ROI numbers even apply to your target role.

items.heading: The Numbers Below Are
items.text: The numbers below are the full picture most comparisons skip: not just tuition, but duration, entrance requirements, and how each programme is typically funded.
